items.title: Applied Scientist - Research Engineer (Formal Methods), EMEA
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on formal methods. You will design, train, and deploy SOTA large language models and apply them to diverse use cases. You'll work cross-functionally with internal and external science, engineering, and product teams to deliver high-impact AI solutions. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on large clusters. - Generate and curate datasets for theorem proving and software verification, and build evaluators and benchmarks for formal reasoning. - Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases. - Manage research projects and communications with client research teams. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills — at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Expert with PyTorch or JAX. - Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance. - Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code. - Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence. - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn. - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia. NICE TO HAVE - PhD / Master in a relevant field (Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning). - Experience with autoformalization, proof automation, or verified code generation. - Experience with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards, ideally from Lean or other proof assistants. - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase. - Publications in top academic journals or conferences. - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Director, Enterprise IT
items.description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK. Contract: Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain) UK: Full-time, permanent Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most: Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom Why People Join Us 🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact. For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home. 🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers. Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. items.title: International Compensation Partner
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking an experienced Compensation Partner to join our Total Rewards team and lead compensation for our international locations as Anthropic builds out its global presence. This role will support our international org on the strategy, design and execution of Anthropic's compensation programs, adapting a global framework to markets that work differently. It is a great fit for someone who has seen compensation excellence at scale and has operated in rapidly scaling, high-ambiguity environments with evolving scope. You'll serve as connective tissue between a fast-moving regional business and a global Total Rewards team. Responsibilities Own compensation for our international locations (such as Germany, France, UK, Ireland, Japan, Australia, India, and beyond as the international team grows), building scalable processes and infrastructure across key markets Support Anthropic's overall compensation framework, including salary, variable compensation and equity-based programs, and adapt it for local market practice, legal requirements, and competitive dynamics while keeping a consistent global philosophy Operate as a strategic compensation business partner to international leadership, People Partners, and recruiting, building relationships and context to navigate ambiguous problems and recommend solutions tailored to Anthropic's unique needs Own comp cycle execution end-to-end for international employees, including local market benchmarking, budget modeling, currency considerations, manager enablement, edge-case resolution, and exec-ready rollups, in partnership with the broader Total Rewards team Navigate complex international regulatory environments, ensuring compliance with local pay and employment requirements across markets, including works councils, statutory pay and benefits requirements, pay transparency obligations, and country-specific equity and tax considerations, in close partnership with Legal and Equity Build and maintain international benchmarking methodology Provide subject matter expertise and counsel to People Partners, managers and leadership on pay decisions, policy and guideline interpretations, and job evaluations across regions Create compelling data narratives and presentations for leadership, translating complex analysis into clear strategic recommendations Partner cross-functionally to develop scalable processes that enable consistent, high-quality compensation decision-making across the organization Develop and deliver enablement on our compensation philosophy and programs across Anthropic for your business stakeholders You may be a good fit if you: Have deep expertise in compensation, preferably in a high-growth environment, with direct experience across multiple countries or regions Have a strong working knowledge of international compensation practices and the regulatory landscape across key markets, including works councils and pay transparency requirements Have experience localizing global compensation programs Excel at collaborating across time zones with exceptional cross-cultural communication skills Have strong collaboration and program management skills, with a track record of taking on ambiguously-scoped projects and taking ownership to deliver great results Thrive in strategic thinking while remaining comfortable with hands-on execution and detailed analysis Are an exceptional communicator, particularly in writing Are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments Strong candidates may also: Speak languages relevant to our international markets (fluency in German, French, Japanese, or other languages is a plus) Have supported a US-headquartered company through rapid international expansion The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £190,000 — £190,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Senior Product Manager, Advisor Marketplace
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency – it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Advisory Products team is redefining the advisor experience by bringing the best of Robinhood’s technology, design, and infrastructure to Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs) and the clients they serve. Following our TradePMR acquisition, we’re building a modern advisor platform – custody, tools, and a two-sided marketplace that connects Robinhood’s investors with trusted, growth-oriented advisors. As the Product Manager for the Advisor Marketplace, you will own the product that helps investors find, meet, and fund accounts with the right advisor – and helps advisors win and onboard those clients efficiently. You’ll own the full marketplace funnel, from demand generation and matching through first meeting, onboarding, and funded account, and you’ll use data and experimentation to make every step work better for both sides. This is an opportunity to take a new, high-visibility business from early traction to scale, in close partnership with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, and Compliance. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Advisor Marketplace, balancing the needs of both sides – investors looking for advice and advisors looking to grow their practices. Own the end-to-end marketplace funnel – discovery, matching and routing, scheduling, first-meeting show rate, advisor onboarding, and funded accounts – and drive measurable improvements at each stage. Define and manage marketplace health: supply and demand balance, advisor quality and standards, lead allocation, and conversion, with clear metrics such as meetings booked and completed, accounts funded, assets under management, and net flows. Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to ship products from concept to production, using research, experimentation, and analytics to guide prioritization and measure success. Work with Compliance, Legal, and Risk to embed regulatory and operational requirements directly into product design, advisor vetting, disclosures, and workflows. Integrate the marketplace with the broader RIA platform, including TradePMR and Robinhood’s app, so that advisor and client data, accounts, and custody flows connect seamlessly. Drive go-to-market execution with Marketing, Sales, and Operations across launches, advisor acquisition and onboarding, support readiness, and cross-functional communication. Explore how AI can improve the client experience when working with an advisor. Stay ahead of trends in wealth management, advisor technology, and marketplaces to inform long-term strategy. What you bring 4+ years of product management experience, including building and launching marketplace, platform, or complex multi-sided products, ideally in fintech, brokerage, or wealth management. Demonstrated success owning a funnel or growth-oriented product end-to-end, with a track record of improving conversion and engagement through experimentation and analytics. Experience delivering products in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment, balancing innovation with operational and regulatory rigor. Strong analytical skills: you define success metrics, write your own queries or dashboards, and use data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement. Strong technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, and operations teams on system design, integrations, and scalability. Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders – including executives, advisors, and partner teams – around a shared roadmap. An ownership mindset and a scrappy, self-starter attitude: comfortable with ambiguity, able to define what “great” looks like as you go. Passion for empowering financial advisors and their clients, and for transforming the wealth management industry through modern technology. Bonus points Experience building two-sided marketplaces, lead-generation or referral products, or CRM and scheduling workflows. Experience shipping AI-enabled features in B2B or consumer products. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Best-in-class benefits, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Lifestyle wallet – a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge, including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $166,000 — $195,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $146,000 — $172,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $129,000 — $152,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Our VIP team supports the firm's highest-value private clients across the Payward ecosystem: high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) who expect a premium, secure, and highly tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the platform of choice for VIPs by delivering white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits. We are looking for a VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM to help us scale our VIP client book and growth across the region. This is a hybrid role: part white-glove relationship management, part growth and business development. You'll build Kraken's presence inside LATAM's VIP trading and investor communities, run local marketing and events, and source new whale relationships. We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to be bold, can build and scale initiatives from the ground up, and is humble enough to fail fast and move on to the next challenge. If you thrive in ambiguity and can operate in a fast-paced, scrappy environment, this role is for you. THE OPPORTUNITY - Serve as the trusted point of contact for Kraken and Payward’s top private clients across LATAM, delivering consistent, high-quality white-glove service and building deep, durable relationships. - Own the regional VIP book end to end: onboarding, tier progression, retention, and proactive intervention on at-risk and lapsing clients. - Build lasting relationships that grow AOP, net deposits, and trading volume, your primary KPIs, by becoming the partner clients trust with more of their capital and activity over time. - Bring Kraken's private client and VIP offerings to market locally, including yield and earn campaigns, lending against tokenized equities and crypto collateral, OTC execution, and structured private-client benefits, ensuring they remain impactful and competitive against regional exchanges and desks. - Source and convert new HNWI relationships through direct outreach, referrals, and introducer networks, from crypto-wealthy individuals and family offices to the principals of trading firms, OTC desks, miners, and project treasuries. - Get inside LATAM's VIP trading communities: private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor groups. Be the Kraken face those communities know and trust. - Design and run local marketing and events (VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent programming, and co-marketing with regional partners and KOLs) in partnership with our Marketing and Regional teams. - Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that produce a repeatable pipeline of qualified private clients. - Act as Payward’s ear on the ground: competitive intelligence on regional exchanges, product gaps that cost us whale business, and the local narratives that move capital. - Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, and Client Service to champion new efforts that drive private client growth and loyalty, and to make sure every play you run is inside Kraken's licensing and compliance perimeter. WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience in relationship management, account management, private banking, brokerage, or private client sales, including at least 2 years in the crypto space, with a track record of working with HNWIs. - An existing, personal network among LATAM's crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, or Chile. - Demonstrated ability to originate business, not just service it. You have personally brought in clients, run events, or built a community presence that produced measurable pipeline. - Deep understanding of trading product solutions, including spot, margin, and futures trading, as well as OTC trading, lending, and yield/earn products. Familiarity with how deposits and client balances drive an exchange's lending economics is a strong plus. - Comfort operating in a regulated environment across multiple LATAM jurisdictions, and the judgment to know when to involve Compliance early. - Highly data-driven, with expertise in analyzing KPIs such as assets on platform, net deposits, trading volume, and client portfolio revenue. - Ability to be scrappy, bold, and unafraid to explore alternative and creative solutions to achieve results. - Deep knowledge of cryptocurrency ecosystems, their players, frameworks, and market dynamics beyond just blue-chip tokens, including how local on/off-ramps and stablecoin flows shape client behavior in the region. - Skilled at building meaningful partnerships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and across diverse backgrounds. - Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for client meetings, events, and conferences. - Based in Brazil and native or near-native Portuguese plus fluent English required. Spanish is a strong plus. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. About the Opportunity MoonPay is building a developer platform that allows partners to create native payment and crypto experiences directly inside their own products. Historically, partners integrated MoonPay through a hosted widget and redirected users into a fixed MoonPay journey. We are now breaking the underlying system into reusable modules covering authentication, identity, KYC, quotes, payment methods and purchasing. These capabilities are exposed through APIs, SDKs, embedded components, iframes and web views. Our goal is for a partner developer to integrate MoonPay’s full capabilities without needing ongoing implementation support from our team. This role owns the developer-facing layer between MoonPay’s underlying payments infrastructure and the products our partners build. You will work across browsers, mobile applications and backend APIs to make complex financial workflows feel simple, predictable and native. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will build the platform itself rather than implementing one-off integrations for individual customers. Build the developer platform Design and build APIs, SDKs and embedded components used by external developers. Turn MoonPay’s existing authentication, identity, payment and purchasing capabilities into reusable platform modules. Develop secure browser and mobile integration patterns across iframes, web views and native applications. Create stable abstractions over complex payments, compliance and crypto infrastructure. Understand the integration deeply Own the complete developer journey, from obtaining credentials through to completing a live transaction. Design clear interfaces for sessions, authentication, quotes, payment methods, transaction state and errors. Handle the realities of browser and mobile environments, including cross-origin communication, redirects, storage restrictions and application lifecycle events. Develop consistent behaviour across web, iOS and Android integrations. Ensure integrations remain secure when operating inside products MoonPay does not control. Make complex systems easy to use Design APIs and SDKs that are difficult to misuse and straightforward to debug. Establish clear versioning, compatibility and migration strategies. Build documentation around how developers actually use the platform rather than treating it as a secondary deliverable. Create useful errors, logs and observability so partners can resolve issues without contacting MoonPay. Reduce integration time and the amount of direct support required from engineering. Operate payment-critical software Build systems where failures can prevent a customer from completing a purchase or leave a partner uncertain about transaction state. Design for retries, duplicate events, delayed responses and dependencies failing in unexpected ways. Implement idempotency, state recovery and graceful degradation across distributed payment flows. Measure API and SDK adoption, integration success, reliability and developer experience. Safely evolve the platform as MoonPay adds products, payment methods, regions and partners. You have strong language fundamentals and have built production client-side or SDK infrastructure. API and SDK design. You understand versioning, backwards compatibility, documentation, error design and safe migrations. Distributed systems. You build correctly when events arrive twice, late or out of order and when dependencies fail. Product judgement. You can turn complex platform capabilities into interfaces that developers can understand and adopt. Ownership. You have taken developer-facing software from design through launch, adoption and ongoing production support. About the Opportunity MoonPay is building a unified identity and KYC platform that can support customers across ramps, cards, virtual accounts and enterprise products. Today, many financial products treat identity as part of a single onboarding flow. We are building it as a reusable platform capability: a secure identity layer that allows customers to verify once, maintain control of their information and access different MoonPay-powered products without repeating the same journey each time. This role will help define the architecture and technical direction of that platform. You will work across product, engineering, compliance and security to determine how identity is captured, verified, stored, linked and exposed safely through APIs and SDKs. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. The problem is not fully defined, and we are looking for someone who can shape the platform while building its most important components. Lead through ambiguity Turn a broad identity and KYC vision into a clear technical strategy, architecture and sequence of deliverable work. Identify the boundaries between identity, authentication, verification, compliance and product-specific onboarding. Set the technical bar through rigorous reviews, clear standards and lasting engineering habits. Align teams across ramps, cards, virtual accounts and enterprise products around a shared identity model. Build the identity platform Design a unified identity layer that can support multiple MoonPay products, partners and regulated use cases. Model the lifecycle of a customer’s identity, including creation, verification, linking, updates, consent and deletion. Build secure APIs and SDKs that allow internal teams and external partners to use identity capabilities without understanding the underlying complexity. Integrate KYC and identity-verification providers while keeping MoonPay’s internal model consistent and extensible. Develop clear ownership boundaries between the identity platform and the products built on top of it. Protect sensitive customer data Define how identity data is stored, accessed and shared across products, jurisdictions and legal entities. Design for consent, auditability, data residency, retention and deletion from the beginning. Build clear authorisation controls around who and what can access verified customer information. Ensure the platform degrades safely when external verification providers or internal dependencies fail. Partner closely with Security, Privacy, Legal and Compliance without allowing the platform to become difficult for developers to use. Create a platform developers trust Build public-facing APIs, SDKs and documentation that make complex identity workflows straightforward to integrate. Establish stable contracts, versioning strategies and migration paths for teams and partners using the platform. Provide observability into identity journeys, verification decisions and integration failures. Reduce the need for product teams to rebuild identity and KYC logic independently. You have built interfaces used by external developers and understand stability, versioning, documentation and backwards compatibility. Sensitive data. You understand the security, privacy and operational requirements involved in storing and processing identity information. Systems thinking. You can reason across data models, verification providers, product workflows, compliance requirements and failure modes. Ambiguity and influence. You have taken a problem nobody had fully scoped, created a technical direction and brought multiple teams with you. Hands-on engineering. You continue to design, build, review and operate production systems rather than leading only through documents and meetings. Nice-to-have experience Built identity or KYC infrastructure within payments, fintech, banking or another regulated environment. Experience with reusable verified identity, identity vaults or portable customer profiles. Experience with OAuth, OIDC, WebAuthn, passkeys, session management or account recovery. Built systems supporting consent, data residency, privacy requests and audit trails. Worked with multiple KYC, KYB or identity-verification providers. Experience building developer platforms for external partners. Familiarity with cryptocurrency, wallets or digital-asset products. Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, Node.js, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes. items.title: CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager
items.description: Better Collective is looking for an experienced CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager to establish and lead a group-wide approach to customer relationship management across our portfolio of global sports media brands. This is a senior role combining CRM strategy, customer lifecycle management, technology, data, commercial thinking and operational leadership . The successful candidate will move CRM beyond campaign execution and develop it as a strategic capability that helps Better Collective build deeper, more valuable relationships with its audiences. Working across Product, Audience, Data, Commercial, Editorial, Technology and local brand teams, the CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will create the frameworks, programmes and operating model required to turn first- and zero-party audience data into personalised customer experiences and measurable business value. The Opportunity Better Collective reaches millions of sports fans across a diverse portfolio of digital brands. The next stage of our audience strategy is to develop stronger direct relationships with those users — moving from anonymous audiences → known users → understood customers → engaged and valuable relationships . CRM will be central to that transformation. The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will establish the strategy, capabilities and standards that allow Better Collective brands to acquire, activate, engage, retain and monetise audiences across the customer lifecycle. Key Responsibilities CRM Strategy & Leadership Develop Better Collective's group-wide CRM and lifecycle strategy. Establish CRM principles, standards and best practices across brands. Create a scalable operating model balancing central CRM expertise with local brand execution. Identify where CRM can deliver the greatest audience and commercial impact. Build CRM roadmaps for priority Better Collective brands. Act as the senior CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation. Customer Lifecycle Management Design lifecycle strategies covering: Acquisition → Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation Develop automated programmes including: Welcome and onboarding journeys Profile completion Content discovery Personalised sports and player updates Newsletter engagement Subscription conversion Premium product promotion Renewal Retention Churn prevention Lapsed-user reactivation Win-back programmes The objective is to create relevant, personalised experiences rather than simply increase communication volume. First & Zero-Party Data Activation Work closely with Audience, Product and Data teams to translate Better Collective's growing first- and zero-party data capabilities into meaningful customer experiences. Use behavioural, declared and transactional data to improve: Audience segmentation Personalisation Content recommendations Lifecycle triggers Subscription propensity Retention Cross-sell opportunities Audience insight Help establish the connection between data capture, customer understanding and CRM activation . Multi-Channel CRM Develop a coordinated CRM approach across: Email Newsletters App push Web push In-app messaging On-site messaging Emerging direct audience channels Establish channel roles, contact strategies, frequency management and customer communication principles. Ensure customers receive coordinated experiences rather than disconnected messages from individual channels. CRM Technology & Automation Partner with Product and Technology teams to maximise Better Collective's CRM technology stack. Responsibilities include: Marketing automation Journey orchestration Audience segmentation Triggered communications Dynamic content Personalisation CRM/CDP integration Data flows Preference management Testing frameworks Reporting requirements Help translate business and customer requirements into practical technology capabilities. Measurement & Optimisation Create a consistent CRM measurement framework across Better Collective. Core metrics should include: Known-user growth Registration conversion Newsletter acquisition Email engagement Push engagement Active-user frequency Subscription conversion Renewal Retention Reactivation Revenue per known user Customer lifetime value Move CRM measurement beyond opens and clicks toward customer behaviour and commercial outcomes . Experimentation Establish a structured CRM experimentation programme covering: A/B testing Send frequency Timing Content Segmentation Personalisation Offers Lifecycle triggers Channel combinations Create mechanisms for successful experiments to be documented and scaled across Better Collective brands. Stakeholder Leadership CRM at Better Collective sits across multiple disciplines. The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will therefore work closely with: Audience — audience strategy, segmentation and zero/first-party data Product — registration, logged-in experiences and product journeys Data & BI — customer data, segmentation and measurement Technology — CRM platforms, integrations and automation Editorial — content propositions and newsletters Commercial — monetisation and customer value Subscription Teams — acquisition, renewal and retention Compliance — consent, GDPR, PECR and data governance Strong stakeholder leadership will be critical to the success of the role. We are looking for an experienced CRM leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to turn strategy into operational programmes. The successful candidate will ideally have: Significant experience leading CRM, lifecycle or customer engagement programmes. Strong knowledge of email marketing and marketing automation. Experience developing sophisticated customer lifecycle strategies. Strong understanding of customer segmentation and personalisation. Experience working with large customer databases. Experience using behavioural and transactional data to improve communications. Strong understanding of CRM technology and platform capabilities. Experience working across Product, Data, Technology, Marketing and Commercial teams. Excellent stakeholder management skills. Experience managing CRM teams, agencies or specialist partners. Strong analytical and commercial mindset. Demonstrable experience connecting CRM activity to measurable business outcomes. Experience within digital media, subscriptions, publishing, sports, gaming or high-frequency digital consumer products would be particularly valuable. Leadership Profile The role requires someone who can operate at both strategic and practical levels. You should be comfortable moving between: Strategy ↔ Execution Customer ↔ Commercial Data ↔ Communications Technology ↔ Marketing Central Strategy ↔ Local Brand Requirements You will need to influence senior stakeholders while also being comfortable working directly with teams responsible for delivering CRM programmes. What Success Looks Like First 3 Months Audit CRM capabilities across priority Better Collective brands. Establish baseline CRM KPIs. Map existing lifecycle communications. Identify immediate optimisation opportunities. Define the group CRM strategy and operating principles. Prioritise brands and lifecycle use cases. 3–6 Months Launch priority automated lifecycle programmes. Establish group segmentation principles. Introduce a structured CRM experimentation framework. Establish CRM dashboards and commercial measurement. Develop CRM playbooks that can be reused across brands. 6–12 Months Better Collective has a scalable CRM capability connecting: Audience Data → Customer Insight → Segmentation → Personalisation → Activation → Measurement → Commercial Value CRM becomes a measurable growth engine supporting: Audience Engagement | Registration | Subscription | Retention | Revenue | Customer Lifetime Value Why This Role Matters Better Collective already has significant global audience scale. The opportunity is to build stronger direct relationships with those audiences. This role will help Better Collective transition from primarily understanding what audiences consume to understanding who our customers are, what they value and how we can build longer-lasting relationships with them . The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will be central to making that transition happen.

items.title: Junior Change Manager
items.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1000 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association . In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification . EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Junior Change Manager join our team in Lviv! About the job: We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Junior Change Manager to support production and infrastructure activities within the CasinoEngine organization. In this role, you will work closely with senior Change Managers, development teams, infrastructure specialists, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure that production changes are properly planned, documented, coordinated, and executed in a controlled and safe manner. You will contribute to the change management process by coordinating activities, facilitating communication across teams, maintaining accurate documentation, and monitoring change execution. While you play an active role in ensuring smooth delivery, responsibility for technical decisions, infrastructure design, and final approval of production changes remains with senior Change Managers and technical owners. This role is a great fit for someone who takes initiative, is not afraid to ask questions, and actively follows up to get the answers needed. We value people who speak up, challenge ambiguity, and think in a structured, logical way about how systems and processes connect. You will regularly engage with engineers and stakeholders across the organization, so confidence, curiosity, and persistence are essential to succeed in this role. This role could be a great fit for someone with a background in project coordination or junior project management and an educational background in IT, engineering, or a related technical field. What You'll get to do: Coordinate production changes, migrations, and switch-overs under the guidance of senior team members. Prepare and maintain change documentation and implementation plans. Ensure required approvals and information are collected before production activities. Communicate with development, infrastructure, operations, and business teams during change execution. Monitor production activities, track progress, and report issues, blockers, and delays. Share status updates on planned and completed change activities. Participate in technical discussions to better understand infrastructure and production processes. Follow change management processes and contribute to their continuous improvement. What You need to know: English level: B1 or higher. A proactive approach - you follow up without being reminded, and you flag problems early rather than waiting for them to surface. Confidence in communication - you are comfortable asking direct questions, pushing back, and speaking up in discussions with technical and senior colleagues. Logical, analytical thinking - you can break a complex change into steps, spot dependencies and gaps, and reason about what could go wrong. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Strong sense of ownership and attention to detail. Willingness to learn technical and operational processes. items.title: Research Engineer, Latency & Throughput
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack. This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production. What You Will Do - Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses. - Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss. - Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack. - Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research. What We're Looking For - A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation. - Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required. - Research experience of some form: a thesis, publications, a dedicated research project, or efficiency-oriented work in a lab or industry research setting. A PhD is not required, but we are looking for genuine research depth. - A track record of conducting experiments: forming hypotheses, designing controlled comparisons, and drawing clear conclusions from results. - Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are. - Self-starter, low-ego, and collaborative. You are comfortable with ambiguity, negative results, and are eager to take matters into your own hands. - Inference or serving experience is a plus, not a requirement. Prior work with vLLM, production LLM deployments, or serving systems will help you ramp up faster. Location and Remote This role is based in our Paris or London offices (hybrid). We will prioritize candidates who reside in the Paris area or are open to relocating. We strongly believe in the value of in-person collaboration to foster strong relationships and seamless communication within our team. For senior profiles, we will also consider remote candidates based in France. In that case, we ask all new hires to visit our Paris office: - For the first week of their onboarding (accommodation and travel covered) - Then at least 3 days per month WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Engineering Lead – AI Enablement (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team AI Enablement builds Raisin's internal AI platform. We make it easy and safe for every team, from engineering and product to business operations, to use AI in their daily work and in the products they build. We provide the shared foundation for that: governed access to AI models and tools, the controls that keep data secure and usage auditable, and the visibility teams need to run AI reliably and cost-effectively. We also shape how Raisin builds software with AI, from AI-assisted coding to agentic workflows that support teams across the development lifecycle. Because Raisin operates in regulated financial services, security and compliance are core to how we design the platform. The team is growing, and you will shape both what it builds and how it works. Your Responsibilities As Engineering Lead, you lead the engineers who build Raisin's internal AI platform and drive the company's AI-assisted engineering practices. You are accountable for the team's delivery, growth, and maintaining the AI platform users' trust. You stay close to the technology, because in a field that changes this quickly, good leadership decisions depend on understanding the technical details. Lead and grow the team Hire, onboard, and develop engineers, and build a team that works autonomously across platform engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Hold regular 1:1s, set clear expectations, and agree individual development plans with each engineer. Give timely feedback, recognise strong performance, and address low performance early. Create an environment of trust, open communication, and continuous learning, so the team keeps up with a fast-moving field without burning out. Own delivery and operations Own end-to-end delivery, from planning and estimation through implementation and release, balancing new capabilities with reliability and maintenance. Make sure the platform runs well in production: on-call, incident handling, and service levels for the systems other teams rely on. Spot risks and blockers early and resolve them, or escalate in time with a clear proposal. Turn the AI strategy into quarterly goals and a roadmap the team commits to, together with your manager and stakeholders. Run the platform as a product Work with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to understand their needs and decide what the platform should offer next. Measure adoption, reliability, cost, and impact, and use that data in planning and when reporting to leadership. Manage the cost of AI usage and tooling, including budgets, licences, vendor relationships, and build-versus-buy decisions. Shape the technical direction Work with the team's tech leads on architecture and key technical decisions, and stay hands-on in design discussions, reviews, and selected implementation work. Work with security, legal, and compliance colleagues to keep the platform and the company's use of AI secure and compliant. Help engineering teams across Raisin adopt AI in their work through documentation, workshops, and direct support. Your Profile What you bring 3+ years leading engineers as an Engineering Manager, Engineering Lead, or Team Lead, including hiring and performance management. 7+ years in software engineering overall, with a background in backend, platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling. Experience leading a team that builds for internal customers, such as a platform, developer tooling, or shared services used by other engineers. A track record of delivering production systems that other teams depend on, including ownership of their reliability. A practical understanding of modern AI integration, such as LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, and agentic workflows, deep enough to evaluate technical decisions and challenge the team. You use AI tools in your own work. Clear communication with engineers, product, and business stakeholders, and fluency in English. Nice to have Experience with AI platform topics such as model access, governance, observability, rate limiting, or cost management. You have driven adoption of new tools or practices across an engineering organisation. Experience leading distributed or hybrid teams. Experience in a regulated industry such as banking or fintech. You don't need to tick every box. If you have led a platform or developer-tooling team and you are excited about what AI changes for engineering, we would like to hear from you. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK. Contract: Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain) UK: Full-time, permanent Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. items.title: Digital Designer, Growth
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team The Design team at Raisin brings together product designers and brand & marketing designers. We are united by a shared belief in respect, creativity, and our purpose to give people financial peace of mind. As our Digital Brand Designer, you'll join the Brand & Acquisition team. We shape how Raisin looks, moves, and feels across every market we operate in: paid and organic social, our websites, product launches, and campaigns. You'll report to the Head of Brand and Marketing Design and work integrated with the US Marketing team. Your main focus is conversion: designing and testing the landing pages, web journeys, and creative that turn interest into sign-ups. You'll also support broader marketing initiatives across paid social, web, and email, so Raisin feels consistent across the funnel. Your Responsibilities Conversion-Driven Web Design: Design, test, and optimize high-converting landing pages, reusable UI components, and end-to-end user journeys that elevate the brand and drive growth, while governing overall website design standards and brand alignment. Data-Informed Experimentation & Testing: Partner with Marketing to turn hypotheses into A/B and multivariate tests, from concept to shipped variant, and iterate based on the results, using funnel analytics, heatmaps, test results, and customer insights to find friction and decide what to test next. Creative Production: Produce static and animated creative, from hero assets to fast, iterative test variations within our brand design. Email & CRM: Design email templates and email campaigns with the CRM team, from lifecycle journeys to product launches. Templates & Systems: Build and maintain reusable templates, modules, and patterns for web, ads, and email, working with Product Design and the Raisin Design System so marketing and product feel like one brand. End-to-End Ownership: Act as a solution-oriented design partner, independently guiding cross-functional stakeholders from problem to execution, taking projects from brief to launch, including prototypes and leveraging AI for implementation-ready tests. Stakeholder Management: Present and explain design decisions with confidence, connecting them to the brand, the customer, and the business result. Workflow Innovation: Use AI tools across concepting, variant production, prototyping, test-implementation and analysis to work faster and test more, without compromising visual quality or compliance. Your Profile 4+ years in digital, marketing or web design, ideally in-house at a fintech, DTC or fast-growing tech company, or at an agency with performance clients. A portfolio that shows strong visual craft across brand, web, landing pages, paid social and email, and that tells the story behind the work: the problem, the hypothesis, what you tested and what changed. Proven experience designing for conversion. You have worked with growth or performance teams and know how to balance brand expression with commercial results. A data-informed mindset. You are comfortable reading test results and analytics, and you use them to make better design decisions. Excellent typography, layout and hierarchy skills, with attention to spacing, rhythm and detail. Expert in Figma, including components, auto layout and prototyping. Solid skills in Adobe Creative Suite. Practical use of AI in your design process today, for exploration, variant production or prototyping, not only for generating imagery. Hands-on ability to build implementation-ready components and code snippets (HTML/CSS) to deploy tests directly with marketing via Optimizely and Bloomreach. Speed without sloppiness. You can manage several projects at once in a fast-moving, feedback-rich environment. Clear communication in English, written and spoken. You can present and defend your work to stakeholders. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS, or experience with AI-assisted coding tools (for example Cursor, v0 or Claude Code). Experience with experimentation tools (for example Optimizely) and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar or Looker. Nice to have Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, where trust and compliance shape the work. Basic motion design skills (After Effects, Jitter, Lottie, Figma Motion, or similar) for ads and web. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Flexible working hours and up to 28 days PTO accrued from your first month, plus 13 public holidays. Employee Development Budget of $2,200 and 4 full training days per year. Company 401k contribution of 5%. Healthcare coverage contribution, including medical, dental and vision. Commuter benefits and flexible working from home policy. Regular team events and yearly Summer and Winter Party Salary Range $105,000 — $120,000 USD Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: - Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution. - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact. - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting. - Are fluent in both French and English - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives. - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
